result.title: Variational Functional Neural Networks (vfNN)
result.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures. Version submitted for peer review
result.summary: We present a variational functional neural network (vfNN) algorithm that optimizes physically motivated continuum functionals in integral form (e.g., Lagrangian, Hamiltonian, or free energy) to find the states of a system. That way, vfNN bypasses solving the equations of motion (a.k.a. the Euler-Lagrange equations), which are in the form of differential equations. To this end, our approach is fundamentally different from conventional physics-informed neural networks (PINN) that solve differential equations by minimizing a phenomenological loss function involving higher order derivatives and ad hoc weight factors. In contrast, vfNN merely evaluates lower order derivatives of the generating functional and replaces the weight factors with rigorous physical scales. This also fundamentally changes the loss landscape, and the desired solutions may become unstable. For this emergent nonconvex optimization problem, we develop a quasi-Newton optimization algorithm with simulated annealing that converges to the solutions of the corresponding Euler-Lagrange equations of the functional regardless of their stability properties. Our simulations using vfNN give accurate results for benchmark systems governed by linear or nonlinear ordinary differential equations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 vfNN，直接以积分形式的物理泛函（Lagrangian、Hamiltonian、自由能）为目标优化系统状态，绕开微分形式的 Euler-Lagrange 方程，并针对由此产生的非凸损失地形设计了带模拟退火的拟牛顿优化算法，在若干线性与非线性 ODE 基准系统上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 把「求状态」表述为泛函极小化而非求解演化方程，并用退火拟牛顿处理非凸地形与解稳定性，可能为 LVR 中将 latent 状态更新视为能量/泛函下降、以及迭代推理中状态稳定性与解选择问题提供可供核查的概念类比。
